status: Source-only protocol frozen; no renderer run or candidate score

notes.pitch_confidence: medium; octave supported by low family
medium-high; octave checked against half-frequency family

source_evidence.periodicity_qualification: Top three normalized stereo autocorrelation peaks,60mswindows,lags60–999. Period multiples and old wet notes create octave/subharmonic ambiguities; not an automatic note selector. Source spectra and stored octave relation are also required.
source_evidence.onset_method: Inspect changed low and upper harmonic families, retain nominal rounded onset plus conservative source bracket; 1024/2048 Hann positive-flux maxima are sensitivity evidence, not exact note-on estimators. Phase/beating and filter attack can move their maxima.

bend_mapping: Nominal G4, range+2semitones; center8192, positive max16383. Median H1/H2/H3 frequency knots1.3–1.9s; fixed center1.2s and maximum2.0s; linear cents interpolation10ms, nearest14bit.
